openai_estimate_basis: First measured local instance of each selected question: 20+9 embedding tokens, 1182 generation input tokens and 153 output tokens. Rates $0.02/M embeddings, $0.15/M uncached input, $0.60/M output. No cached discount assumed. Live context/output/cold starts may differ. Health costs no OpenAI tokens.
ecr_basis: Current deployed compressed image 216147543 bytes; assume up to 250 MB entirely additional billed storage, no layer-dedup/free-tier credit. Actual new size unknown until approved build. AWS ECR $0.10/GB-month; upload and same-region Lambda transfer $0. No deletion planned, so storage continues.
aws_assumptions: Local workstation build; no CodeBuild/EC2. Existing Lambda 1024 MB x86_64; 15 aggregate billed seconds across 3 invocations (cold-start/init can exceed this). 100 KiB logs, 1 MiB NAT traffic, 10 KiB endpoint egress, up to 3 Secrets Manager reads; no credits/free-tier assumed. Existing gp2 RDS has no per-read I/O charge. These are estimates, not hard caps.
existing_costs_not_incremental: Existing NAT/IPv4/RDS/storage continue whether deployment happens or not. If this work alone extends runtime by 15 minutes, allocate NAT $0.01125 + one NAT public IPv4 $0.00125 + RDS compute $0.004 = $0.0165; existing storage and any CPU-credit charges additional. No lifecycle start/stop requested.
openai_retry_note: Smoke HTTP client will not retry. Existing API get_openai_client uses max_retries=2; preserving code means internal retries remain possible. Conservative model-wide ceiling for two generation requests with three attempts each: about $0.1741824 plus <=$0.00048 embeddings at 4000 tokens/attempt; not an expected cost or an enforced cap. No hard live OpenAI cap is implemented in production.
live_status: No live tests of new code; local metrics must remain labeled local.
